source_reviews.review_mode: Original author institution-hosted PDF downloaded. Printed2770/PDF2 Figure1a observed currents and printed2771/PDF3 Figure2 bottom signed-zonal-velocity section actually viewed. Methods PDF1 and prose identify campaign, instruments, current/leg and separate model. Conservative100m labeled-depth presence reading, no speed/boundary digitization.

excluded_substitutions: Figure1a observed25–75m averaging window does not establish physical endpoints or reach75m by itself.
Figure1b nominal0–115m model layer is separate from observed Figure2.
Full ADCP21–300m nominal measurement range does not establish current bottom; failed northern-leg instrument and repair are not new SECC depth measurements.
Preparis Eddy140m core, EUC60–140m and tentative northern NECC100m are distinct named features.

references.geographic_scope: Eastern Indian Ocean SECC neighborhood around6S on I9N eastern leg, nominal95E. Regional observed case east of selected90E atlas handoff.
references.temporal_scope: Two-leg Knorr survey6February–21March1995; exact eastern SECC occupation days not recovered. Northeast monsoon snapshot, not seasonal climatology.
references.source_definition: OSW inferred inclusive reach from eastward flow presence at labeled100m in original Figure2 bottom zonal-velocity section, with SECC identity from Figure1a and Results prose.
references.source_citation: Hacker, Firing, Hummon, Gordon and Kindle(1998), Bay of Bengal currents during the northeast monsoon, GRL25:2769–2772, doi:10.1029/98GL52115.
references.source_locator: Figure2 bottom panel and caption, printed2771/PDF3; Figure1a and caption printed2770/PDF2 identify SECC and observed25–75m means; Results printed2771 right column and Methods printed2769 distinguish current, legs, dates and model.
references.qualification: Conservative presence bound, not detected flow bottom, thickness or statistical significance. Qualitative contour/sign reading only; no speed digitization. Exclude westward SEC farther south, equatorial EUC60–140m, northern tentative NECC and Preparis Eddy. Figure1a25–75m is an averaging window, not paired physical boundaries; Figure1b nominal115m model layer and full ADCP300m sampling limit are not observed SECC endpoints. Eddy/recirculation variability and author discussion remain; no continuity along the full current or seasonal range.
